### Added

- *(agent-platform)* List and read skills through the installation's skill-manager in [#3432](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3432) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(muster)* Sort the Connectors list by name, by header click, all at once in [#3444](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3444) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(ui-react)* One new-tab icon for every external link, and link a skill's Path in [#3443](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3443) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* The organization credential form in [#3435](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3435) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Put muster's URL elicitations to the person and retry the call with their answer in [#3459](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3459) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- Move agent instructions to AGENTS.md in [#3454](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3454) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(agent-platform)* Restore private skill catalogs after reload in [#3452](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3452) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Set an agent reply's paragraphs at 14px again in [#3455](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3455) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
